profile.name: Christopher Alexander Sutandhya
profile.headline: Bridging business needs with thoughtful digital solutions.
profile.intro: I turn complex business requirements into structured processes, intuitive experiences, and practical technology solutions.
profile.about: With a background in Information Systems and Business Analytics, I enjoy connecting people, processes, and technology. My work spans business analysis, financial analysis, and UI/UX design, with an emphasis on clarity, collaboration, and measurable value.
